error.cannot_connect: Unable to complete the Remeha Home login. Please try again later.

auth.description: Set up the Remeha Home integration using your Remeha Home credentials.

reauth_confirm.description: Failed to refresh the Remeha Home access token. Please re-authenticate with your Remeha Home credentials to continue using this integration.

get_schedule.name: Get schedule
get_schedule.description: Return the switch points of a climate zone time program.

set_schedule.name: Set schedule
set_schedule.description: Replace the switch points of a climate zone time program. Use get_schedule to see the current format.

switch_points.name: Switch points
switch_points.description: List of {day (0-6, as returned by get_schedule), time (HH:MM), activity (1-5)}.

get_hot_water_schedule.name: Get hot water schedule
get_hot_water_schedule.description: Return the switch points of the hot water time program.

set_hot_water_schedule.name: Set hot water schedule
set_hot_water_schedule.description: Replace the switch points of the hot water time program. Use get_hot_water_schedule to see the current format.

set_holiday.name: Set holiday
set_holiday.description: Put the appliance in holiday mode for whole days. The current zone, hot water and operating modes are saved and restored when the holiday is cleared or ends.

device_id.name: Appliance
device_id.description: Appliance device. Leave empty for every Remeha appliance.

clear_holiday.name: Clear holiday
clear_holiday.description: End holiday mode now and restore the modes saved by Set holiday.

device_id.name: Appliance
device_id.description: Appliance device. Leave empty for every Remeha appliance.

set_temporary_override.name: Set temporary temperature
set_temporary_override.description: Hold another temperature in a zone that follows its clock program, until the end of the duration. The appliance then returns to the clock program by itself, also when Home Assistant isn't running.

duration.name: Duration
duration.description: How long to hold it, from 1 minute to 7 days.

get_energy_history.name: Get energy history
get_energy_history.description: Read the daily energy figures of an appliance for a range of complete days from the Remeha cloud, with totals and COP for the period. Read-only: no entities or statistics change.

end_date.name: End date
end_date.description: Last day. Shortened to the last complete day (yesterday from 06:00, otherwise the day before).

device_id.name: Appliance
device_id.description: Appliance device. Can be left empty with one appliance.

include_days.name: Include days
include_days.description: Return each day as well as the period totals.
